summary: Most Python files should begin, after the comment header, with from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function) for Python 3 semantics.
questions: What __future__ import should Ansible Python files have?

answer_card.title: future-import boilerplate
answer_card.answer_md:
Right after the comment header:
```python
from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
```
This gives Python 3 import, division and print semantics.
